borrower_entity: TTRES CO Wheat Ridge Kipling St, LLC
repayment_summary: I/O during Construction Period (through Conversion Date); if Extension exercised, P&I on 30-yr amort at then-prevailing rate, re-amortized annually
lead_lender_role: Sole Bookrunner / Lead Arranger / Administrative Agent
lender_contact: James A. Leikam, SVP — BOKF, NA dba Bank of Oklahoma (Tulsa)
guaranty_reduction_terms: Reduces to 30% at Substantial Completion; further reduces to 25% upon DSCR >= 1.25:1.00 as of last day of any calendar quarter beginning on/after Conversion Date (excluding curative quarters); no re-increase
dscr_formula: Income: T3 gross rental income from leases with tenants in occupancy. Expenses: T3 actual (ex-net-income taxes, depreciation/amortization, debt service); no mgmt fee floor, no per-unit reserve add. Rate assumption: greater of (A) note rate, (B) 6.75%, or (C) 10yr UST + 250 bps. Amortization: 30-yr
significant_covenants: Ongoing DSCR >= 1.25:1.00, tested end of each calendar quarter ending after the quarter Conversion Date occurs; 30-day cure by pay-down or cash collateral; cash collateral release after 3 consecutive months at 1.35:1.00. TTH NW/Liq: $15M liquidity / $75M NW, tested quarterly
extension_term_changes: Amortization commences on Conversion Date (30-yr amort, level P&I, re-amortized at each annual anniversary at then-current rate)
extension_test_summary: DSCR >= 1.15:1.00 for most recent 3-month period AND LTV <= 60% per new appraisal; no Default/EOD; Borrower may cure DSCR/LTV by paying down principal
financial_reporting_borrower: Quarterly (within 65 days, beginning quarter of Substantial Completion): internally prepared BS and IS, Compliance Certificate, rent roll + occupancy info upon commencement of leasing. Annual (until quarterly kicks in; within 125 days of fiscal year-end beginning 12/31/25): internally prepared BS
financial_reporting_guarantor: Quarterly (within 65 days): CPA-reviewed financial statements, global real estate schedule, brokerage statements, contingent debt schedules. Annual: federal tax return within 30 days of filing
miscellaneous: Equity Deposit: $23,278,603.99 to be deposited with BOKF within 10 BDs of Closing; usable only for Approved Project Costs. All operating/deposit accounts maintained with BOKF; treasury management services required. Retainage: 10% initial, reducible to 5% upon 50% of hard costs billed. HVCRE compliance required at all times. Late fee: 5% of payment if 15+ days late

type_specific.development_fee_funding: 25% at closing / 50% in equal monthly installments during Construction Period / 25% at Substantial Completion
